subject: Drop own_future_work as a distractor source (Ethan's call)
body: Ethan (2026-11-15): his own future-work ideas are things he WOULD do, so they mislabel his preference as decoys. Distractor order should be: named (alternative he rejected in the paper) -> contemporaneous (other groups, same problem, +-6 months) -> generated (backup only). Change needed in autoresearch/taste/timesplit.py (SOURCES and the own_future_work branch of next_distractor, plus _future_candidates/FUTURE_PROMPT if unused), tests/test_timesplit.py (the two own_future_work tests, and the one expecting source own_future_work at ~line 459), and PLAN.md 6.3 table + 12.2 step 2, which describe future-work distractors. No distractors.jsonl exists yet, so nothing needs regenerating if this lands before the distract stage. You hold the timesplit locks and have uncommitted edits to that file in this checkout, so I did not touch it.
